ui.chat.aside.adopt.confirm.note: The shortcut is shown as written by the platform.

placeholders.cap: the shortcut as displayed (for example ⌘+F or Ctrl+F); never translated

ui.chat.aside.adopt.confirm.role: hint after the first press of the add-aside shortcut asking for a second press
ui.chat.aside.adopt.confirm.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.failed.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.failed.role: fallback error when adding an aside failed with no message
ui.chat.aside.adopt.failed.tone: one short sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.not_landed.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.not_landed.role: error when the add request was refused
ui.chat.aside.adopt.not_landed.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.queued.note: A turn is one agent reply cycle.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.queued.role: status after adding an aside while the agent is mid-turn
ui.chat.aside.adopt.queued.tone: status, em dash, consequence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.open_tool_ba.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.open_tool_ba.role: reason an aside could not be added: the conversation stopped mid tool call
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.open_tool_ba.tone: two sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.session_clos.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.session_clos.role: reason an aside could not be added: the conversation closed
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.session_clos.tone: one sentence with a colon, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.turn_running.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.turn_running.role: reason an aside could not be added: the conversation is busy and cannot queue
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.turn_running.tone: two sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.adopt.unconfirmed.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.unconfirmed.role: error when the app could not confirm the aside was added
ui.chat.aside.adopt.unconfirmed.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.announce.answered.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.announce.answered.role: screen-reader announcement when an aside finished with no readable first sentence

ui.chat.aside.announce.answered_truncate.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.

placeholders.text: the first sentence of the aside's answer cut to the announcement length; model-written text shown verbatim

ui.chat.aside.announce.answered_truncate.role: screen-reader announcement carrying a shortened first sentence

ui.chat.aside.announce.answered_with.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.

placeholders.text: the first sentence of the aside's answer; model-written text shown verbatim

ui.chat.aside.announce.answered_with.role: screen-reader announcement carrying the aside answer's first sentence

ui.chat.aside.announce.asking.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.announce.asking.role: screen-reader announcement while an aside is answering
ui.chat.aside.announce.asking.tone: short status in the gerund, no trailing period

ui.chat.aside.announce.not_answered.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.announce.not_answered.role: screen-reader announcement when an aside failed

ui.chat.aside.ask_busy.note: Enter is the key name and stays literal.
ui.chat.aside.ask_busy.role: message when the user tries to ask another aside while one is still streaming
ui.chat.aside.ask_busy.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.ask_queued.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.ask_queued.role: message when the user tries to ask again while the previous aside waits to be added
ui.chat.aside.ask_queued.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.blocked.nothing.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.blocked.nothing.role: reason the add-aside control is unavailable when the aside failed
ui.chat.aside.blocked.nothing.tone: very short sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.blocked.nothing_yet.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.blocked.nothing_yet.role: reason the add-aside control is unavailable before any exchange
ui.chat.aside.blocked.nothing_yet.tone: very short sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.blocked.settling.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.blocked.settling.role: reason the add-aside control is unavailable while the aside is still finishing
ui.chat.aside.blocked.settling.tone: one sentence with an em dash, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.blocked.working.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.blocked.working.role: reason the add-aside control is unavailable while the agent is working
ui.chat.aside.blocked.working.tone: two sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.continuation_escape.note: Esc is the key name and /btw is a command; both stay literal.
ui.chat.aside.continuation_escape.role: aside panel message when the aside can no longer continue
ui.chat.aside.continuation_escape.tone: two sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.declined_options.note: Esc is the key name and stays literal.
ui.chat.aside.declined_options.role: aside panel message offering the next step after the model declined to answer
ui.chat.aside.declined_options.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.model_no_text.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.aside.model_no_text.role: reason when the model answered an aside without any text
ui.chat.aside.model_no_text.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.not_answered.note: An aside is an off-the-record side question answered without joining the conversation; /btw starts one.
ui.chat.aside.not_answered.role: error line on the aside panel when the aside question got no answer
ui.chat.aside.not_answered.tone: one short sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.aside.off_panel_refusal.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.

placeholders.question: the user's aside question, already quoted
placeholders.cause: the already-localized reason, or the backend's message verbatim

ui.chat.aside.off_panel_refusal.role: notice in the conversation when an aside asked while its panel was closed got no answer
